1. (Currently Amended) A system for lexical navigation of a corpus of items, comprising: a processor; and a memory, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to: generate a data structure comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generate a top-level lexical cloud, comprising a subset of the plurality of keywords, wherein each keyword in the top-level lexical cloud has an associated size that is proportional to the keywords frequency of appearance in the data structure; and generate a lower-level lexical cloud by: __receiving a user selection of a keyword from the top-level lexical cloud__; __creating a temporary data structure by removing any items not associated with the selected keyword__; and __generating the lower-level lexical cloud from the temporary data structure, wherein each keyword in the lower-level lexical cloud has a size proportional to its frequency of appearance in the temporary data structure__.

2. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to __receive a user selection of a keyword in the displayed lexical cloud and filter the data structure based on the selected keyword__.

3. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to display a subset of the plurality of items based, at least in part, on __a first keyword selected from the top-level lexical cloud and a second keyword selected from the lower-level lexical cloud, wherein the subset is determined by the intersection of items associated with both the first and second keywords__.

4. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, comprising a storage device that comprises __technical documents, patents, Web pages, word processing documents, spreadsheet documents, or any combinations thereof, wherein the storage device is communicatively coupled to the processor__.

5. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 4, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to access files stored in the storage device and to generate the plurality of keywords from the files __using natural language processing__.

6. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a number of keywords in the top-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on a size of a display area __and a minimum frequency threshold for keyword inclusion__.

7. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a number of keywords in the lower-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on a size of a display area __and a minimum frequency threshold for keyword inclusion in the temporary data structure__.

8. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a size of each keyword in a lower-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on the frequency of the keyword in the temporary data structure __relative to the total frequency of all keywords in the temporary data structure__.

9. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to select a subset of the plurality of keywords based, at least in part, on a frequency of occurrence of each keyword in the data structure __and a ranking algorithm that prioritizes keywords by frequency__.

10. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate the top-level lexical cloud, a plurality of lower level lexical clouds, or both __dynamically in real time in response to user interactions with the system__.

11. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate a list of items to display based, at least in part, on a size of a display area __and the keywords selected from the top-level and lower-level lexical clouds__.

12. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate at least part of the plurality of keywords for the data structure based, at least in part, on __metadata extracted from the plurality of items or measurements from a sensor associated with the items__.

13. (Currently Amended) A method for lexical navigation of a corpus of items, comprising: generating a data structure in a non-transitory, computer readable medium, comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generating a top-level lexical cloud, wherein the top-level lexical cloud comprises a subset of the plurality of keywords, and wherein each keyword in the subset is proportional in size to an overall frequency of occurrence of the keyword in the data structure; __receiving a user selection of a particular keyword from the top-level lexical cloud__; and generating a lower-level lexical cloud by: __eliminating any one of the plurality of items not associated with the selected particular keyword from the data structure to create a temporary data structure__; and generating the lower level lexical cloud as a second subset of the plurality of keywords that remain in the temporary data structure, wherein each keyword in the second subset is proportional in size to an overall frequency of occurrence of the keyword in the temporary data structure.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the second subset is chosen by the overall frequency of occurrence in the temporary data structure __after elimination of any items not associated with the selected particular keyword__.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, comprising obtaining the plurality of keywords by: obtaining a list of words associated with an item; excluding common words from the list; __stemming or lemmatizing words to obtain the plurality of keywords__; and storing each of the plurality of keywords in the data structure.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, comprising displaying a list of items selected from the plurality of items based, at least in part, upon __a first keyword selected from the top level lexical cloud and a second keyword selected from the lower level lexical cloud, wherein the displayed list comprises only items associated with both the first and second keywords__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, comprising generating at least part of the plurality of keywords for the data structure based, at least in part, on __metadata, aesthetic descriptions, or other attributes provided during physical examination or cataloging of the items__.

18. (Currently Amended) A non-transitory, computer-readable medium, comprising code configured to direct a processor to: generate a data structure comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generate a top-level lexical cloud, comprising a subset of the plurality of keywords, wherein each keyword in the top-level lexical cloud is sized proportionally to its frequency of appearance in the data structure; __receive a user selection of a keyword from the top-level lexical cloud__; and generate a lower-level lexical cloud by __creating a temporary data structure by removing any items not associated with the selected keyword from the data structure and generating the lower-level lexical cloud from the temporary data structure, wherein each keyword in the lower-level lexical cloud is sized proportionally to its frequency of appearance in the temporary data structure__.

19. (Currently Amended) The non-transitory, computer-readable medium of claim 18, comprising code configured to direct the processor to __receive a user selection of a keyword from the displayed lexical cloud and filter the data structure based on the selected keyword__.

20. (Currently Amended) The non-transitory, computer-readable medium of claim 18, comprising code configured to direct the processor to display a subset of the plurality of items based, at least in part, upon __a first keyword selected from the top-level lexical cloud and a second keyword selected from the lower-level lexical cloud, wherein the subset comprises only items associated with both keywords__.
